description: Call someone from one of the brand's numbers. With bridgeTo (the user's own phone; default: the number's forwarding phone), that phone rings first and, once answered, to is dialled from the brand's number, so the caller ID is the business. With agent (a voice agent's SIP address, or a wss:// stream on Twilio), the agent places the call to the person instead. record:true records it. The provider bills the call to the account. Free in credits. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: place_call
title: Place a phone call
